summary.text: H. Denise Wooten is the Democratic nominee for the Texas House of Representatives, District 63, and a psychologist by profession.
She was also a candidate for the same seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Wooten earned a bachelor's degree from William Jewell College in 1982 and a graduate degree from Baylor University in 1989, according to Ballotpedia.

In an earlier Ballotpedia survey response, she described herself as a licensed clinical psychologist of 35 years specializing in Autism Spectrum and ADHD, a seven-year adjunct professor of psychology at a local community college, and a member of the leadership team of Flower Mound Area Democrats and of the Texas Psychological Association's legislative team.
In the 2022 general election for District 63, Ben Bumgarner defeated Wooten.

In her 2026 survey answers, Wooten named fully funded public education, affordable and accessible medical and mental health care, and the affordability of essentials such as housing, groceries and childcare as her three key campaign messages.
